audit_scope: Independent Phase 169 audit, timestamp provenance forensics, execution economics verification, and historical strategy lineage

findings.expected_behavior: Conversational report prose must cite exact raw microsecond timestamps from authoritative venue captures (1792419977351882 us and 1792419978695455 us) dated 2026-10-19T14:26:17-18Z.
findings.actual_behavior: Phase 169 completion text quoted timestamps 1760805669389773 us and 1760805669931707 us, creating an apparent 1-year discrepancy.
findings.root_cause_analysis: Forensic audit proved that 1760805669 is exactly 31,536,000 seconds (365 days) earlier than 1792341669, corresponding to 2025-10-18T16:41:09Z. The time 16:41:09 matches the previous Phase 167 trade on 2026-10-18. The discrepancy was an assistant conversational transcription defect that conflated the prior experiment with a 1-year epoch conversion error. The raw venue evidence files in research/captures/ were never corrupted.
findings.remediation: Hardened core/reconciliation/execution_economics_verifier.py with microsecond magnitude assertions (16 digits), UTC datetime conversion, year validation (year == 2026), and cross-leg chronology checks. Authored 11 focused regression tests in tests/test_timestamp_provenance_phase170.py.
findings.remaining_uncertainty: Zero. Verified mathematically and cryptographically against raw capture bytes.

findings.expected_behavior: Reconciliation engine must verify that wallet fee postings occurred chronologically after or contemporaneously with REST fill execution, rejecting premature postings.
findings.actual_behavior: Phase 169 verifier validated running balance progression and transaction created_at ordering, but did not cross-reference wallet timestamps directly against REST fill execution timestamps.
findings.remediation: Extended verify_chronological_balances to accept fill_timestamps_utc, verifying that fee postings post-date execution (with 50ms network skew buffer) and occur in strict chronological sequence.

findings.area: Historical Strategy Lineage & Change Detector Pins
findings.expected_behavior: Historical strategy pins must remain intact as change detectors, failing red against modified trees until full research pipeline recertification is authorized.
findings.actual_behavior: Five historical tests fail against the current working tree (c52e648c... vs 9c56f3ff... raw / ba17582d... LF).
findings.root_cause_analysis: The pin reflects pre-Phase-4 uncommitted Windows working tree state before modular decoupling of Alpha Strategy Core (v1.1) from Runtime Infrastructure (v1.1). Subsequent commits introduced intentional improvements (Phase 4 shadow gates, Phase 132-C cost wiring, Phase 164 paper fill updates).
findings.remediation: Retained as BLOCK-170-01. Pins were NOT modified or silenced. Versioned dual-identity architecture maintained in core/research/strategy_identity.py.
findings.remaining_uncertainty: Recertification requires full out-of-sample research pipeline execution.
